programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programmes.d: An investigation into the practice of past-life regression therapy; a technique where subjects are placed under hypnosis in order to recover memories of supposed past lives.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Chemtrails
programmes.d: What on Earth are they spraying? Richard travels into the field to meet several researchers who present compelling evidence that chemicals or biological agents are being deliberately sprayed into the atmosphere by some shadowy government agency.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Antichrist
programmes.d: End times prophecy experts discuss the possible identity of the antichrist and the timing of his emergence onto the world state.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Electronic Harassment
programmes.d: Two victims of alleged electronic harassment and organized gang-stalking recount their horrible ordeals. Richard investigates possible theories as to who is behind this program and why.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Demonic Possession
programmes.d: The religious practice known as exorcism is examined as well as claims of demonic possession. Richard travels to a Catholic seminary in Yonkers, New York.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programmes.d: Is a powerfully rich cabal with a globalist agenda conspiring to destroy sovereign nations and impose authoritarian rule?

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programmes.d: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programmes.d: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programmes.t: Past Hunters: The Block
programmes.d: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: Trapped and Retreat

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: The Evil Down Below
programmes.d: A scientist discovers footage on his security camera that even he can't explain; and a sailing ship from the 1800's is home to a ghostly crew.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: The Incubus
programmes.d: Spirits from an abandoned slaughterhouse invade a couple's home. People at a health club work out under the watchful eyes of a cigarette-smoking ghost; and an Ohio woman is violated by a paranormal incubus in her own bedroom.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Haunted Weir Mill
